scope: The Haas-Lilienthal House exterior at 2007 Franklin Street in San Francisco as photographed in May 2015. Includes the 1886 main residence, pointed southeast turret, stair and covered entry, multiple gables, and the attached 1929 rear guest and garage wing. Interiors and neighboring buildings are outside the reconstruction.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The owner identifies the 1886 Queen Anne house, 2007 Franklin Street address, wood gables and circular corner tower.

Survey CA-1160 describes the two main storeys, high basement, large attic, pointed southeast turret, four intersecting gables, exposed south chimney, recessed attic balcony, 8+10 stair risers and connected 1929 garage/guest wing.
